sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: BLAS DGEMM：轉置契約與行列索引
related.titleEn: BLAS DGEMM: transpose contracts and matrix indices
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四塊流水圖、緩衝所有權與同步反例；33/25正確且沒有跨塊依賴違反，合成重疊前提逐項列出；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver four-chunk pipelines, buffer ownership and synchronization counterexamples. Verify 33/25 with no dependency violation and explicit synthetic overlap assumptions. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫A列、B欄與C元素，註明row-major或column-major介面和leading dimension單位；27/22與手算一致，矩陣形狀、轉置旗標及stride可重建。
related.differenceEn: Draw A row, B column and C element, labeling layout and leading-dimension units. Verify 27/22 and reconstruct shapes, transpose flags and strides.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想三階段每塊a,b,c，k塊流水時間a+b+c+(k−1)max(a,b,c)，假設引擎獨立且緩衝足夠；合成H2D3、計算7、D2H2毫秒，k4；改計算5，其餘不變；名義式 3+7+2+3*7 = 33 ms；變更式 3+5+2+3*5 = 25 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
C=αAB+βC0；對同一元素先做內積，再套α與β，不能省略舊C項；A第一列[1,2]，B第一行向量列為[3,4]，C0(0,0)=5；α2，β1；改β0；名義式 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0,0)；變更式 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0,0)。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal three-stage pipeline time is a+b+c+(k−1)max(a, b, c), assuming independent engines and sufficient buffers. Synthetic H2D = 3, compute 7, D2H = 2 ms, k 4; compare compute 5. Nominal 3+7+2+3*7 = 33 ms; changed 3+5+2+3*5 = 25 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

C=αAB+βC 0; compute the dot product before applying α/β, and retain the old C term. A row 0=[1, 2], B column 0=[3, 4], C0(0, 0)=5, alpha 2, beta 1; compare beta 0. Nominal 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0, 0); changed 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0, 0). Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Monte Carlo：抽樣誤差與有效樣本
related.titleEn: Monte Carlo: sampling error and effective samples
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四塊流水圖、緩衝所有權與同步反例；33/25正確且沒有跨塊依賴違反，合成重疊前提逐項列出；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver four-chunk pipelines, buffer ownership and synchronization counterexamples. Verify 33/25 with no dependency violation and explicit synthetic overlap assumptions. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫試驗→0/1觀察→分組平均，記seed、全域樣本ID及是否重複；兩SE相符，獨立性、樣本唯一性與p來源明示。
related.differenceEn: Trace trial, binary observation, and batch mean. Record the seed, global sample identity, and any duplication. Both standard errors must match, with independence, sample uniqueness, and the source of p stated.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想三階段每塊a,b,c，k塊流水時間a+b+c+(k−1)max(a,b,c)，假設引擎獨立且緩衝足夠；合成H2D3、計算7、D2H2毫秒，k4；改計算5，其餘不變；名義式 3+7+2+3*7 = 33 ms；變更式 3+5+2+3*5 = 25 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

已知教學p時，樣本均值標準差SE=sqrt(p(1−p)/N)，前提是獨立同分布；合成p=.25，N10000對40000；這是模型SE，不是某次量測信賴區間；名義式 sqrt(.25*.75/10000) = 0.00433012701892 probability standard error；變更式 sqrt(.25*.75/40000) = 0.00216506350946 probability standard error。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal three-stage pipeline time is a+b+c+(k−1)max(a, b, c), assuming independent engines and sufficient buffers. Synthetic H2D = 3, compute 7, D2H = 2 ms, k 4; compare compute 5. Nominal 3+7+2+3*7 = 33 ms; changed 3+5+2+3*5 = 25 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For teaching probability p, the sample-mean standard error is sqrt(p(1−p)/N), assuming independent identically distributed trials. Synthetic p = 0.25, N = 10000 versus 40000. This model standard error is not a measured confidence interval. Nominal sqrt(.25*.75/10000) = 0.00433012701892 probability standard error; changed sqrt(.25*.75/40000) = 0.00216506350946 probability standard error. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
